key_findings: Dimethyl fumarate attenuated paclitaxel-induced thermal hyperalgesia and cold/mechanical allodynia in rats.
DMF reduced dorsal horn p38 MAPK and BDNF, lowered IL-6/IL-1beta, and increased sciatic nerve Nrf2 expression.
